recent.title: chess sequencer
recent.summary: Every position has pressure, protection and silence. Move a piece and hear the relationships change. Colored outlines reveal what the music responds to: attacked pieces add tension, protected pieces sustain, and crowded pieces become quieter. Full chess rules apply; piece type sets the instrument, color sets its register, and the sound palette is yours to choose.

articles.title: chess sequencer
articles.summary: Every position has pressure, protection and silence. Move a piece and hear the relationships change. Colored outlines reveal what the music responds to: attacked pieces add tension, protected pieces sustain, and crowded pieces become quieter. Full chess rules apply; piece type sets the instrument, color sets its register, and the sound palette is yours to choose.

articles.title: untended
articles.summary: A vanitas bouquet, shared by everyone who opens this page. Every real visit resets its clock; every full day nobody does, it earns one permanent scar, and enough of them and it eventually dissolves into pixels and noise. It always sits behind a haze until you touch it — hover across the canvas to wipe a patch clear and see what still holds underneath.

recent.title: the house band
recent.summary: The six sequencers, left on. Every game is always being played, engine against engine, each at its own tempo, so their sweeps drift in and out of phase. Choose which members are on: one alone is a solo, all six is a wash. Nothing is streamed. Every move is worked out from the clock, so everyone hears the same games at the same moment, each mixed their own way.
